output_list.criticism: The function _transfer() does not check for integer overflow. If the balanceOf[_from] is greater than or equal to the _value, the balanceOf[_to] will be increased by _value. However, if the balanceOf[_to] is greater than or equal to the sum of the previous balance and _value, the balanceOf[_to] will be increased by _value. This will cause an integer overflow if the balanceOf[_to] is close to the maximum value of uint256. This can be exploited to steal tokens from the contract.
